panel_a: Exact annual additive UMRI changes for 2000–2025; 10 regional trajectories and 50 regional component endpoints accompany the pooled overall estimate. Annually valid centres are pooled separately for each region and overall.
panel_b: Native retention m and capacity C percentages, mean paired change in patch concentration q=C/m in percentage points, and native urban pressure p percentages.
panel_c: Means and descriptive centre distributions for recovery and canopy change; C<C0 and m<C0 fractions use the same greener-neighbourhood denominator.

centre_distribution.groups: Overall and 10 regions, each with r_2025_pct, EVI_delta and NDMI_delta.
centre_distribution.estimand: Equal-weight reference-centre distribution of existing 500 m neighbourhood quantities
centre_distribution.canopy_mask: m_2025 > 0 and finite current and local baseline values
centre_distribution.recovery_zero_handling: All valid 2025 centres, including known local absence and true zeros
centre_distribution.baseline: Local 2000-2004 baseline; NDMI baseline is the median of at least three valid years
centre_distribution.interpretation: Descriptive spatial spread; not confidence intervals or independent replication

patch_concentration_change.definition: Mean of neighbourhood-level q=C/m differences between 2000 and 2025 on the same valid endpoint support; not the ratio of regional mean C to mean m.
patch_concentration_change.support: Positive retention and valid q at both endpoints
patch_concentration_change.interpretation: Descriptive change in the connected configuration of retained habitat; no independent causal attribution or significance test.

retention_reconnection_limit.markers: Upper connection glyph: C<C0; lower square: m<C0; both use all greener neighbourhoods as denominator
